newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Chevron set to unveil Gorgon development.
newsitem.headline: Chevron set to unveil Gorgon development.

text.p: Chevron Corp has said it was close to proposing a multi-billion dollar development of the Gorgon gas field near the North-West Shelf (NWS) off the northern coast of Western Australia, The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Tuesday.

Chevron's chairman and chief executive Ken Derr had confirmed that Chevron would soon propose to have Gorgon gas piped to the North-West Shelf liquefied natural gas (LNG) project at Karratha for conversion into LNG, the Financial Review said.
"I think that we are very close to being in a position to make a joint proposal to the NWS participants on how this would be structured," Derr told the newspaper.
"Obviously, to do that will also require development of markets for one or two more trains," he said.
The Gorgon field, one of Australia's largest, is owned by the Western Australia Petroleum Pty Ltd (WAPET) consortium.
WAPET is a joint venture of Texaco, Chevron Inc and Royal Dutch/Shell Group, each with two-sevenths stakes, and Mobil Corp, with one-seventh.
